newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Experts optimistic on Australia rig stability.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Experts optimistic on Australia rig stability.

text.p: Experts inspecting a drilling rig disabled during installation off the South Australian coast were cautiously optimistic about its stability, a spokesman for explorer Canyon (Australia) Pty Ltd said on Tuesday.
The assessment followed concerns the 8,500 tonne rig, which still contains lubricants, diesel fuel, engine oil and other drilling materials, could collapse in the Gulf St Vincent.
Canyon spokesman Chris Rann said the company hoped, as aerial and underwater inspections continued, to be able soon to determine how and where the rig could be repaired.
Local sources have said the rig was expected to be transported by owner/operator Maersk Drilling (Australia) Ltd APS for repair at an Asian port.

One of the rig's legs was damaged at the weekend in the first stage of a A$15 million petroleum exploration programme by Canyon, which is 100 percent owned by private Texan based oil and gas explorer and producer Wagner and Brown Ltd.
